nolviko.google.title: Sign in with Google
nolviko.google.reauth: Confirm your password first; changing these settings needs a confirmation from the last 15 minutes.
nolviko.google.reauth_hint: Saving is available after a password confirmation:
nolviko.google.from_config: The Google client is set in config/local.php or the environment, which wins over this page.
nolviko.google.error_client_id: The client ID should look like 1234567890-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com.
nolviko.google.error_secret: Enter the client secret (8 to 200 characters, no spaces).
nolviko.google.error_failed: The settings could not be saved. Try again.
nolviko.google.saved: Saved. The Google button now appears on the sign-in and registration pages.
nolviko.google.removed: The Google client was removed; the button no longer appears.
nolviko.google.status_on_help: Members can sign in and sign up with Google.
nolviko.google.status_off_help: Follow the steps below; the button appears once the client is saved.
nolviko.google.step_console: Open the Google Cloud Console, choose or create a project and go to APIs & Services, Credentials:
nolviko.google.step_client: Create credentials, OAuth client ID, application type Web application. If asked, set up the consent screen first (app name, support email).
nolviko.google.step_redirect: Add this address under Authorized redirect URIs, exactly as shown:
nolviko.google.step_paste: Copy the client ID and client secret Google shows and paste them below.
nolviko.google.no_site_url: The site address is not known yet (it is written during installation); it is needed for this address.
nolviko.google.secret_kept: Saved; leave empty to keep it
